Gangway Bellows Replacement: Separate Envelope, Frames and Floor Bridge

Prepare a bellows-only replacement inquiry with fold geometry, mounting profiles, movement data and material requirements, distinct from a complete gangway order.

November 14, 2026 · Passenger Access · Ma'anshan Railwheel Industrial Technology Co., Ltd.

Identify the flexible envelope accurately

The word gangway can mean the whole passage system, while bellows usually identifies its flexible enclosure. A replacement inquiry must identify the actual supplied item. Separate the envelope from end frames, mounting strips, seals, floor elements and interior trim. A price for flexible material alone should not be evaluated as a price for a ready-to-install complete system.

Measure interfaces rather than a damaged silhouette

Record the controlled mounting profile, attachment layout and nominal installed geometry. Where fold count or corner construction is design-controlled, include those details. A damaged bellows may be stretched, compressed or distorted when photographed. Its apparent free shape is not a reliable source of all production dimensions. Recover the original definition or an authorized replacement specification.

Engineering principle: nominal opening and deformation reserve are different

The opening at the reference condition does not state how much extension, compression or lateral deformation the envelope can accommodate in its approved construction. Fold geometry and attachment constraints determine how the enclosure changes shape. Treating the bellows as generic stretchable material loses that construction-specific behavior. A replacement review should connect the approved range to the actual folds, joints and mounting arrangement. Material qualification supports the specified construction within its scope; it does not independently determine the complete movement reserve of every enclosure made from the same fabric.

Connect material requirements to construction

Material evidence must describe the proposed product construction rather than an unrelated fabric sample. Where environmental, fire, smoke or other requirements apply, identify the required test basis and configuration. Do not transfer a manufacturer's published compliance claim to a different laminate, joint or assembly. Ask the supplier to identify its proposed material and construction against the actual requirement schedule.

Retain the vehicle movement definition

A replacement envelope must work within the approved installation and movement range. It should not be selected only because it closes the opening at the nominal position. State the compressed and extended configurations and the relevant combined movement cases from the approved design. Any proposal to change folds, attachments or stiffness needs a review of its implications for the installed system.

Define fit verification and handover

Agree which dimensions are checked at the supplier and which need the receiving fixture or vehicle. Inspect the delivered identity, attachments, joints and required records against the order. Confirm packaging that protects folds and mounting profiles without introducing uncontrolled distortion. Installation and vehicle release remain under the authorized maintenance process, including any required inspection of reused parts.

Application scenario

Illustrative scenario: a coach refurbishment buyer asks for new bellows but expects old end frames to be reused. The scope review identifies attachment details missing from the inquiry. The buyer adds the interface drawing and confirms the condition review of reused frames rather than ordering a complete gangway unnecessarily or assuming a generic bellows will fit.

Technical review checklist

Checks to define in the project documentation
Review itemRequired definitionPurpose
EnvelopeFold and material definitionIdentifies the replacement itself
AttachmentsProfiles and controlled layoutDefines compatibility with reused parts
MotionApproved installed rangeChecks more than the nominal opening
AcceptanceConstruction evidence and fit checksMatches records to the actual product

Frequently asked questions

Does a bellows quote include frames?

Not unless frames are explicitly included in the agreed supply schedule.

Can a fabric test report establish the complete bellows compliance?

Only within its stated scope. The actual construction and applicable assembly requirements need their own relevance review.
